name: rabadon
description: The reliability runtime for AI coding agents. Stands between a live agent session and the world: refuses the force-push before it rewrites history, stops the loop on its third identical spin, holds untested pushes, and keeps a tamper-evident ledger of everything it caught.

scripts.test: node --test core/rabadon.test.mjs core/wrap.test.mjs core/bus.test.mjs core/store.test.mjs ui/server.test.mjs hooks/install.test.mjs hooks/gate.test.mjs demo/live-repair-evidence.test.mjs
